meta_title: JM Plumbing & Gas | Emergency Plumber Plymouth
meta_description: JM Plumbing & Gas Plymouth offers emergency plumbing, boiler repair, and gas safety work. Fast response, Gas Safe registered. Call now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Plymouth? We arrive fast, diagnose on site, and fix most jobs the same day.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Gas Services Across Plymouth
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full installations, we handle every plumbing and heating job with the same care and speed.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes
services.desc: Leak discovered at midnight? We attend within 60 minutes, locate the source, and stop the water damage fast. Available every day, every hour.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Service
services.desc: Cold radiators or no hot water? We diagnose faults on the spot, carry common parts on the van, and aim to restore your heating same day.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual gas appliance safety checks and CP12 certificates for landlords and tenants. Scheduled at your convenience, report provided same day.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full boiler and system upgrades with 10-year warranties. We handle all pipework, fit the right-sized boiler, and commission it fully.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold spots in your radiators? We bleed them, check for leaks, and balance your heating so every room warms evenly.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap replacement, toilet repairs, sink unblocking, and full bathroom refits. We work neatly and tidy up after ourselves.

about_pullquote: I started this because I hated waiting four hours for a plumber. Not anymore.
about_para_1: JM Plumbing & Gas has been serving Plymouth and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. Founded on the simple idea that emergency plumbing shouldn't mean a huge bill or a long wait, we've built a reputation for speed, honesty, and proper workmanship. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and fully trained in modern heating and plumbing systems.
about_para_2: We're a local, family-run business — not a call centre. When you ring, you speak to us directly, and we turn up when we say we will. Our customers come back because we fix things right the first time, charge fair rates, and treat your home with respect.
reviews_heading: What Plymouth Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on Boxing Day evening. Rang JM Plumbing expecting a long wait and a hefty call-out charge. Mark arrived within 45 minutes, found the problem, and had it fixed and running before 8pm. Brilliant service, really fair price. Will use again without hesitation.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in during the winter. I phoned three other plumbers and couldn't get anyone. JM answered straight away, came out the next morning, and replaced the whole thing by afternoon. Professional, friendly, and didn't try to oversell. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Needed my gas safety certificate done for the landlord. Booked online, engineer arrived on time, checked everything thoroughly, and emailed the certificate same day. Quick, efficient, no messing about. Recommend them fully.
reviews.author: James K.
